selected_evidence.requirement: Identify node1's interface facing lan-b and node3's counterpart
selected_evidence.summary: Enumerated node1 interfaces (vtnet0/1/2), node3 interfaces (enp1s0/enp8s0), and confirmed via ARP resolution (REACHABLE, matching MAC) that node1's vtnet2 is L2-adjacent to node3's enp8s0 — the lan-b link.

selected_evidence.requirement: Bring node1's lan-b interface into service as its own zone with an address
selected_evidence.summary: Added opt1/LANB interface bound to vtnet2 with static IP 10.100.47.1/24 and a firewall pass rule to config.xml, applied live via configctl; ifconfig confirms UP with correct address and description LANB (opt1).
Configured node3's enp8s0 to 10.100.47.3/24 via nmcli and confirmed successful bidirectional ping to node1's 10.100.47.1.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node2 on lan-a through node1's lan-b interface
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed IP forwarding enabled on node1; added a temporary /32 route via 10.100.47.1 on node3 and observed successful ping to 10.100.46.11 with TTL=63 (one hop less than direct path's TTL=64), proving traffic actually transited node1's routing/firewall; test route removed afterward.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node1 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Captured kern.boottime baseline (1788626589), issued shutdown -r now, observed SSH timeout during reboot, then confirmed new kern.boottime (1788626912) and recovered lan-b interface/connectivity to node3 post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node2 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id baseline (fb2aa416...), issued systemctl reboot, observed connection errors during reboot, then confirmed new boot_id (52851d02...) and recovered connectivity to both node1 and node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node3 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id baseline (d052eb57...), issued systemctl reboot, observed connection errors during reboot, then confirmed new boot_id (35bee981...) and full recovery of enp8s0 addressing, routes, and reachability to both node1 (lan-b) and node2 (lan-a through node1).
